messages.text: Hi, my friend Hugo asked me to sort out the refund for his speaker, order d07-o2. Can you refund it to my card?

Sorry, I can’t handle Hugo’s refund through your account: this policy covers only orders placed by the signed-in customer (refund-policy/v2/scope). A refund also cannot be sent to another person’s card; it can only go to the order’s original payment (refund-policy/v2/payment).
